slides.title: Mendham Borough Library
slides.body: Free or discounted museum tickets, plus e-books and streaming on Libby and Hoopla.

slides.title: Mendham Township Library
slides.body: Babies Morning Out, a kids chess club and a Nov. 19 local history talk are on its calendar.

slides.title: The Holly Trail
slides.body: Mendham Borough's annual Holly Trail fills downtown and ends with a tree lighting at the gazebo. Photos with Santa are free, but you need a reservation.

slides.title: 2 towns, one name
slides.tip: Mendham Borough and Mendham Township are 2 separate towns. Check which one a home is in.
